verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships automation-like features, such as online scoring and scheduled Patterns runs, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows that these automations can be versioned, reviewed as change history, or rolled back. The only versioning evidence covers datasets and immutable experiment records, which are adjacent objects and not automations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
